creator: Claude
name: Compact Wood Stove
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 0.05 m (detail tier) is essential here, as the brief allows. Every functional feature the brief lists is 2-5 cm in reality: hinge knuckles, latch handle, air slider slots, 15 cm feet and the 5 cm plate overhangs that give a cast stove its silhouette. At 0.10 m the 0.8 m body is only 8 cells wide and those features become whole 10 cm cubes, i.e. a generic furnace block. The firebox is genuinely hollow, so the count stays about 1.3k voxels.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the plinth/top-plate footprint (0.80 x 0.65 m); the latch handle and slider lever protrude a further 0.10 m at the front.
front_note: +Y is the loading door / interaction side.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude pilot palette (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.

flue_outlet.description: Centre of the open top of the 15 cm flue collar; a vertical pipe attaches here.

collision_hint: Box 0.80 x 0.65 x 0.90 m at the pivot plus a 0.2 m cylinder for the collar.
story: A squat cast-iron box stove in daily use: pot-polished lid, heat-bronzed iron and a soot streak above the door, a low bed of embers behind smoked glass, damp rust only where the feet meet the floor.
notes: Body (top plate) at 0.85 m, raised cooking lid to 0.90 m, flue collar rim at 1.00 m.
Smoked window is opaque by design (no transparency needed); embers are the only warm accent.
The firebox is a real hollow cavity reachable through the flue collar.
